# Royce Labs AI Solutions

> Royce Labs builds and runs an AI assistant that answers property enquiries on WhatsApp for real-estate developers and agencies in India, Tamil Nadu first. A buyer messages the developer's WhatsApp Business number; the assistant replies in English or Tamil, asks consent, captures budget, location and size, shows up to three matching listings, and passes a site-visit request to the developer's team. A small paid 30-day pilot is open in Coimbatore; the fee is agreed by email, in writing, before anything starts. Applying is free. Other Tamil Nadu cities are on a waitlist. Languages today: English and Tamil only, so no pilots in other states yet.

## What it does

- Replies to property enquiries on WhatsApp in English or Tamil, and reads Tanglish.
- Understands lakh and crore, cents and grounds, and terms such as patta, chitta, DTCP and CMDA.
- Asks consent before saving anything; STOP or "no" revokes it.
- Matches the buyer's budget, area and size to the developer's own listings (up to three).
- Passes site-visit requests to the developer's team through a broker console. The team confirms or declines.

## What it never does

- Quote or negotiate a price.
- Take money, Aadhaar or other ID documents.
- Book a site visit without the developer confirming.
- Message buyers who did not contact the developer first.
- Invent a listing it does not have.

## Current status (stated plainly)

- Built and tested offline: the English and Tamil conversation, consent handling, listing matching and the broker console.
- Not yet proven: live WhatsApp with real buyers. The pilot is the first live run.
- Planned, not live: re-engaging dormant leads, and a Tamil and English phone agent. Both wait until the WhatsApp pilot has proven itself and a lawyer has checked consent and telecom rules.

## Pilot

- Pricing: not published. The pilot fee is agreed by email, in writing, before anything starts; applying is free. Cancel after 30 days, no lock-in.
- For: plot and layout developers (DTCP / CMDA) and agencies or brokers with steady WhatsApp enquiries. Coimbatore first, then Chennai and beyond.
- Prices are pilot prices and may change.
